items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 43:1
items.html: For the essence of the Partzuf is the measure of the Katnut that was in it, as is known. And since at the time of Katnut it had only two vessels — Galgalta and Einayim, which are Keter and Hochma — the light of Ruach was clothed in Galgalta, which is therefore called HGT, and the light of Nefesh was clothed in Einayim, which are therefore called NHY. It follows that the screen of the ending is in the vessel of Einayim. Hence, even at the time of its Gadlut, when the bottom Hey descended from Einayim to Peh, since it acquired its AHP, still the imprint of the bottom Hey from the time of Katnut remains in its Einayim. Namely, in the old NHY that rose and became HGT, where the vessel of Yesod became the upper third of Tifferet, so that the screen of Katnut is found at the place of the chest, as is known. Therefore the new AHP that it attained at the time of Gadlut are considered the aspect of posterior and judgment, because they are found below the chest, namely below the aspect of the ending of Katnut. Hence a great distance is made between the vessels of the face of the Partzuf, which are Rosh and Guf from the chest and above, which are above the screen of Katnut and are considered the aspect of GAR, and the new AHP, which are the four lower Sefirot, TNHY, which are below the screen of Katnut, which are the aspect of lacking a Rosh, since they are found below the screen of ending from the time of Katnut. And this is the secret of what our sages, of blessed memory, said concerning Moses our teacher, peace be upon him (in Midrash Tehillim) on the verse “A prayer of Moses, the man of God” — that from his waist and above, Moses is called Elohim, and from his waist and below he is called a man. (884, Sub Header, “And The Reason”)
